title: Add native centre capture and local fixed-reader services
body:
This construction puts centre records into existing native data fields while preserving every arbitrary input baseline. It packages productive row capture, clean selected exchange and its dual, row-involution responses, and complete D25 forward/dual services for a fixed past reader. A separate route32 response has two dyadic capture codes. The direct clean comparator gives complete 2,912-scalar words with a different, larger native profile. **These local results do not improve the complete kappa calculation.** A recursive helper host, closed caller, finite map price, terminal decoder, and complete precision bound remain open.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/PROOF.md), [exact claim and review index](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/CLAIM-INDEX.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json), [fresh validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/VALIDATION.json), and [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/publication-reviews/native-centre-capture/REVIEW.md) give the adopted scope. All 640 input fields are arbitrary. The complete local words preserve the 416 outside values; that fact does not give those values productive progress or construct a recursive host.

For the actual sixteen selected ports, `L=V_P^-1 V=[I,B]` and `C=[[I,B],[0,I]]` have a dyadic code costing 1,760 scalar primitives. Formation keeps the arbitrary `Ly` baseline. Line-entry reuse keeps the same reader. Clean exchange instead sends each selected pair `(Lx,b)` to `(-b,Lx)`, so the old baseline remains in selected X while selected Y holds a clean centre. Its inverse-adjoint keeps the chronological order and every unitary native operator, including global phase. A selected-field conjugate is implemented by explicit instruction labels under matching physical types.

The row completion sets `U'_P=V_P^-1(-2I-V_R U_R)` and `A=I+U'V`. It preserves all 96 ordinary rows and gives `A^2=I`. The general rank statement is `rank(A-I)=16`; `rank(A-E)=16` is separately checked for this source. The complete D25 reader uses `A_t`, then the past reader `L_s`, then `A_t` again to restore X. The forward service adds `D_st x`; the complete dual subtracts `D_st* w`, including the native prefix, actual owner paths, DATA views, full-cover barrier, and late query. Both providers and pairs `(0,1),(0,2),(1,2)` are checked. The physical input level is `t-1`, including pair `(0,2)`.

The [literal cost table](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/COSTS.md) keeps the different interfaces separate:

| Complete local word | Real scalar primitives | Native mass |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Formation / same-reader line entry | 11,640 / 9,880 | 1,808 / 1,792 |
| Clean I entry / Q entry | 8,600 / 8,600 | 1,808 / 1,792 |
| Native A / native A transpose, either direction | 9,416 / 8,936 | 1,808 |
| Complete D25 fixed-reader forward or dual | 14,896 | 1,792 |
| Route32 raw, either direction | 4,312 | 1,792 |
| Direct Fsimple or Bcustom | 2,912 | 1,984 |

The D25 service has 1,520 children and at most 4,384 map calls. The direct pair has `96 H1 + 128 H8 + 96 H9`: 320 children and at most 448 native side maps, with no boundary adapters. It is distinct from the separate 4,632-scalar phase-coded word. Native mass and scalar counts alone do not compare complete recursive costs. The original formation derivation retains preliminary prices 2,048 and 3,696; the final reviewed actual pivot code and query prices are 1,760 and 3,424.

Route32 has `rank(E-I)=32`, determinant `3^24`, and a rational inverse with factors of one third. Its two capture codes use only dyadic units and cost 1,870 and 2,486 scalars per direction. Its rank minimum is restricted to the stated route-homogeneous clique partition family. The formal `q C q` code diagonalizes `Q E q`; it is not a raw decoder. The producer-only common-W lift and whole-W reflection decoder are not adopted.

The [historical budget appendix](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/HISTORICAL-BUDGETS.md) uses `b=67018507072324140917/40000000000000000000000`, from the [selected certificate](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/certificates/selected-result.json) and [assembly](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/community-frontier1094-audit/ASSEMBLY.json) at `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Three clean Q calls allow 196 extra H1 or 98 H2; one I and two Q allow 180 H1 or 90 H2. The coalesced fixed profile allows 198 H1 or 99 H2, reduced to 134 H1 or 67 H2 after a stipulated 64-H1 cleanup. These are alternative conditional allowances. They do not admit the composition, cleanup, or a 224-H1 terminal decoder.

The publication base is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Its [selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51/certificates/selected-result.json) names [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). The historical inputs in this package have different source and caller contracts. No transfer to the current selected construction is claimed.

The native lineage uses the [core source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2/research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold/README.md) from [PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133) at `51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`, the provider copies in [PR #3148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3148) at `f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176`, and the recipe tools from [PR #2588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2588) at `8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb`. The [retained provider credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/vendor/PR3133-CREDITS.md) identifies @dcharb78 for the coupled folds and helper endpoints. Jeremy Diviney (@jeremydiviney) supplied the provider copies and packing/exchange integration, as recorded in the [exact PR #3148 source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/README.md). The [PR #2588 notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb/research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/NOTICE) credits Rohan Arun (@rohanarun) for native lowering and owner construction and Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) for the borrowing and warp lineage of [PR #2226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2226). The [package notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/NOTICE.md) records campaign contributions, unchanged predecessor notices, and Apache-2.0 licensing. OpenAI Codex gave substantial assistance. The separate agent reviews are not human peer review or formal-kernel verification.

Use Python 3.11 or later, the standard library, one process at a time, and at least 3 GiB of free disk. Python 3.14.7 on macOS was tested. From the repository root, use new output directories:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/native-centre-capture/replay.py --out /tmp/native-centre-capture-normal
python3 -I -B research/native-centre-capture/replay_budgets.py --out /tmp/native-centre-capture-budgets-normal
```

The expected final lines are:

```text
PASS_NATIVE_CENTRE_CAPTURE_REPLAY
PASS_NATIVE_CAPTURE_HISTORICAL_BUDGETS
```

The new extraction ran all eleven main stages and three budget stages in normal mode. Every main receipt matched the frozen bytes. The separate publication reviewer repeated all stages from a relocated copy in optimized mode with Git unavailable. The historical freezes also retain their earlier normal/optimized checks. The budget receipts match in every field except the two declared adapter self-hashes; the [exact I/O diffs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a42061bdf5b8974baa21a0a4097bbc9de3a0da1c/research/native-centre-capture/adapters/ADAPTATIONS.json) replace only historical Git reads and one output destination.

The fresh independent checkers enumerate all 512 spatial basis columns for each of the 297 new route32 kernels and each of the 209 direct-clean kernels, including global phase. The complete content replays keep arbitrary inputs and owner order. Controls reject missing transfers, wrong exchange signs, omitted source restoration, wrong past readers, wrong dual chronology, and wrong translation order. The budget replay recounts 24 earlier raw/changed words and eight clean words and verifies 176 low-displacement intervals plus the clean and coalesced strict thresholds. Inherited phase tables are bound by exact ordered-record equality. No complete historical compiler regeneration, full repeat of inherited phase censuses, current selected-supplier replay, or complete host, caller, precision, or kappa calculation ran.
